description: This file implements SAML login and logout handling for Mattermost, including initiating SAML requests, processing responses, managing user sessions, and handling mobile and desktop-specific flows.

classes.name: Web
classes.description: A struct representing web handlers, including SAML authentication endpoints.

methods.name: InitSaml
methods.description: Initializes SAML endpoints for login and completion.

methods.name: loginWithSaml
methods.description: Handles the initiation of a SAML login request, building and redirecting to the SAML identity provider.

methods.name: completeSaml
methods.description: Processes the SAML response, authenticates the user, manages sessions, and handles mobile/desktop flows.
